subject: Demo notes + proposed evaluation charter & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@nebulahealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo notes + proposed evaluation charter & kickoff plan

Hi Amelia / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we keep momentum for the trial:

Demo highlights (what we showed)
- Live ingest + semantic search for clinical notes (30k docs demo dataset)
- Low-latency Q/A chain and redaction examples for PHI-safe exports
- Cost projection for 10k qps reads with caching and 8-seat trial usage

Proposed 3-week evaluation charter (high level)
1) Week 0 — Kickoff & environment prep
   - Confirm data subsets for the trial (Carlos to share sample export)
   - Grant access to Nebula team to dedicated trial workspace
2) Week 1 — Integration & smoke tests
   - Connect one clinical service and validate end-to-end latency
   - Run the standard evals (response quality, hallucination checks)
3) Week 2 — Load and acceptance
   - Load scaled queries and measure 95p latency / cost metrics
   - Formal sign-off on success criteria and go/no-go

Draft success criteria (please review)
- Avg token latency (inference) <= 350ms for 95% of queries
- Top-1 answer accuracy >= 88% on Nebula eval set
- No high-severity PHI leakage incidents during test runs
- Integration validated by Nebula infra team (artifact checklist)

Attachments: I attached a short "POC charter" and an evaluation checklist that map owners to tasks. If these look good, can we lock a kickoff for next week? I proposed 20/21 May slots on the shared calendar; if neither works we can shift to the week after.

Next actions I’m proposing from Redwood:
- Aditya will own integration support and smoke tests.
- Marissa (CS) will track acceptance criteria and run the evaluation checklist.

Please reply with any edits to the success criteria and preferred kickoff date. Happy to adjust scope to meet your procurement windows.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Nebula_POC_Charter_v1.pdf; redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx

From: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@nebulahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo notes + proposed evaluation charter & kickoff plan

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. Carlos and I reviewed the proposed charter and overall this looks aligned with what our team discussed internally. A few notes and constraints from our side:

1) Timeline — procurement has one standard SLA turnaround; if we kick off 20 May we likely won't be able to exchange signed documents until the 28–30 May window. So we prefer to start environment prep and non-binding integration steps this week and formally kick off smoke tests after PO is in place.

2) Success criteria edits: please add an availability target for the trial environment (>= 99.5% during scheduled test windows) and specify data retention: log retention <= 30 days.

3) Data sample: Carlos will share a 2GB anonymized export to the S3 bucket by EOD today. Expect his message with upload link.

4) Procurement: looping in procurement so they can flag any required paperwork.

We'll aim for the 27th or 28th for the formal kickoff if procurement clears — can you hold both days? Also, can you confirm the required IP whitelists we need to configure for the dedicated trial workspace?

Thanks — Amelia
Amelia Ross
Director of AI Platforms | Nebula Health
amelia.ross@nebulahealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amelia Ross <amelia.ross@nebulahealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo notes + proposed evaluation charter & kickoff plan

Thanks — quick tech notes from my side so we can finalize the checklist: 

- IP allowlist: provide the account CIDR ranges and one static egress IP block. I’ll share the exact values (redwood-trial-ips.txt) by EOD.
- Data ingestion: We support CSV, JSONL, and S3 event-based pulls. For the anonymized export Carlos mentioned, JSONL is easiest for schema mapping. If Nebula prefers CSV we’ll provide a mapping script.
- Model variant: For this workload I recommend the quantized p4d-2 model (balanced latency/cost). We’ll provision a single-node dedicated instance for the trial and enable KV prefix caching for repeated queries.
- Telemetry: We’ll push a short live dashboard with token-level latency and cost. Marissa will need access to Nebula stakeholders for the acceptance sign-off flows.

I attached the integration checklist and a small shell script to validate credentials and bucket access. I’ll be on standby during the kickoff window.

—Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood-integration-checklist.md; redwood-trial-ips.txt

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Demo notes + proposed evaluation charter & kickoff plan

Great — thanks for the quick feedback, Amelia.

Plan update and next steps (finalized):
- Environment prep (non-binding): this week — Carlos will drop the anonymized export link. Aditya will supply IP ranges and the integration checklist.
- Formal kickoff: tentatively 27 May at 10:00 AM PT (holding both 27/28 until procurement confirms).
- Acceptance criteria: updated per Amelia — added 99.5% environment availability and 30-day log retention. Updated charter attached.
- Owners:
   - Redwood: Aditya (integration), Marissa (acceptance/eval), Tessa (commercial/coordination)
   - Nebula: Carlos (data/infra), Amelia (stakeholder sign-off), Procurement (contracting)

Attachments included: Nebula_POC_Charter_v1.pdf (updated with availability & retention rows) and the evaluation checklist. I also added a short kickoff agenda in the charter doc.

Action items for Nebula before kickoff:
- Confirm whether you’ll provide JSONL or CSV export (Carlos)
- Approve the kickoff slot or propose alternatives (Amelia / Procurement)

If procurement wants a formal SOW or an order form before the kickoff, we can accelerate that in parallel — I can loop in our legal ops.

Looking forward to getting started.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
